seo.description: Apply to ITTI and take the first step toward a professional career in aviation, travel and tourism with flexible online and on-campus options.

props.title: Follow these steps to submit your application and secure your place in our aviation and hospitality programs.

props.editor:
Step 1: Complete the Application Form

Download and fill out the ITTI application form completely. Ensure all personal and academic information is accurate before submission.

Step 2: Prepare Your Supporting Documents

Along with your completed application form, you will need to submit:

  • Two (2) passport-sized photographs

  • Copies of your academic certificates (high school, previous qualifications, or relevant professional certifications)

Make sure all copies are clear and legible.

Step 3: Submit Your Documents

Submit your completed application form and supporting documents to:

The Administrative Department
International Travel & Tourism Institute
Jupiter House – on the Motorway Extension towards Abeka Lapaz from the Tetteh Quarshie Roundabout, Accra

You can also reach out for more information or guidance:

  • Email: frontdesk@ittighana.com

  • Telephone: +233 54 545 4022

1. Foundation (Airfares and Ticketing)

  • WASCE with aggregate 24 or better

  • GCE O’Level, A’ Level, RSA, City & Guilds

  • 3 years post Sec. (Teachers)

2. Any other programme offered by ITTI

  • WASCE with two years work experience with a reputable organization

  • Certificate in any discipline

  • Diploma / HND / Degree

  • 25 years and above with at least 3 years work experience

  • IPMC / NIIT Training Certificate

  • Pre-university Courses

  • Any equivalent course to/above WASCE

3. Ramp Certification (Turn Around Coordinator – Trc)

  • 1ST DEGREE

  • HND

  • Driver’s License
